record_type_quote: This investigation reports on a conceptual replication of Goldman et al. (2012) which sought to determine processing patterns of better and poorer learners as they attempted to comprehend and learn from seven textual sources on the Internet in their native language English.

targets.authors: Goldman, S., Braasch, J., Wiley, J., Graesser, A., & Brodwinska, K.

targets.evidence_quote: This investigation reports on a conceptual replication of Goldman et al. (2012) which sought to determine processing patterns of better and poorer learners as they attempted to comprehend and learn from seven textual sources on the Internet in their native language English.
